program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rot90 cells)
      (let ((h (+ 1 (apply max (map first cells)))))
        (normalize-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- h 1 (first p)))) cells))))
    (define (rotate cells k)
      (let loop ([i 0] [cur (normalize-cells cells)])
        (if (= i (modulo k 4)) cur (loop (+ i 1) (rot90 cur)))))
    (define ctrl (first (find-color g 1)))
    (define code (cond [(and (= (first ctrl) 0) (= (second ctrl) 0)) 0]
                       [(and (= (first ctrl) 0) (= (second ctrl) (- (cols g) 1))) 1]
                       [(and (= (first ctrl) (- (rows g) 1)) (= (second ctrl) (- (cols g) 1))) 2]
                       [else 3]))
    (define a (first (find-color g 3)))
    (define b (first (find-color g 6)))
    (define dr (- (first b) (first a)))
    (define dc (- (second b) (second a)))
    (define shape (obj-cells (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0)))))
    (define bb (bbox-of-cells shape))
    (define trans (rotate shape code))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([p (in-list trans)])
      (let ((r (+ (first bb) dr (first p)))
            (c (+ (second bb) dc (second p))))
        (if (in-bounds? r c (rows g) (cols g))
            (set-cell out r c 8)
            out)))))
